about.missionBody: To advance knowledge in computer science and data science through excellence in education, innovative research, and community engagement. We are committed to preparing graduates who are equipped with the technical skills and ethical foundation to lead in the digital age.
about.visionBody: To be a nationally and regionally recognized faculty of excellence in data science, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity education and research, fostering innovation and contributing to Egypt's digital transformation.
about.historyBody: The Faculty of Computers and Data Science was established as part of a national initiative to meet the growing demand for skilled professionals in data-driven fields. Since its inception, the faculty has grown to encompass six specialized departments, offering cutting-edge programs that blend theoretical foundations with practical applications. Our graduates serve in leading roles across technology companies, research institutions, and government agencies.
about.leadershipBody: The faculty is led by a distinguished team of academics and administrators dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of education and research. Our governance structure ensures transparency, inclusivity, and continuous improvement across all academic and administrative functions.
